mentions.name: Jeden
mentions.description: A habit tracker that supports flexible goal formats beyond daily streaks, such as completing a habit N times per period.
mentions.problem: Habit trackers are typically limited to daily goals, which is too inflexible for habits that fit better as N times per period.
